# Yahoo

> > Yahoo is a comprehensive web portal offering news, finance, email, search, and digital services with breaking coverage of politics, markets, and current events.

Yahoo provides integrated access to Yahoo Mail, Yahoo Finance (stock quotes for Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq), Yahoo News (breaking headlines on Trump, political developments, and global events), and Yahoo Search. The platform also offers developer tools including OAuth authentication and web performance best practices.

## Key Topics

- Yahoo Mail
- Yahoo Finance
- Yahoo News
- Breaking news and headlines
- Stock market and financial data
- Web search and trending topics
- Account authentication and security
- Trump and U.S. politics
- Market indices (Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq)
- OAuth and developer tools
- News aggregation
- Current events coverage
- Web performance optimization
- Account recovery and support

## Core Services

- [Yahoo Homepage](https://yahoo.com): Yahoo homepage aggregating news, finance, sports, entertainment & weather
- [Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com): Breaking news aggregator covering Trump, HMPV virus, entertainment & politics
- [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com): Stock quotes, Fed policy updates, market data on Dow/S&P 500/Nasdaq indices
- [Yahoo Mail Login](https://mail.yahoo.com/�): Yahoo Mail login page with country code selection for account access
- [Yahoo Search](https://search.yahoo.com): Yahoo Search homepage with trending searches and web portal navigation
- [Yahoo Search (US)](https://us.search.yahoo.com): Yahoo Search portal with trending topics including NHL, Nancy Guthrie, Iran

## Help & Support

- [Fix Sign-In Problems](https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN2051.html): Account recovery troubleshooting: password reset, 2-Step Verification, Yahoo ID
- [App Passwords for Third-Party Access](https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN15241.html): Guide to creating app passwords for third-party Yahoo Mail access
- [Yahoo Customer Support](https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6349.html): Yahoo Help Central overview with support channels and contact options

## News & Current Events

- [U.S. News](https://yahoo.com/news/us): U.S. national news featuring Lindsey Halligan, Russia-Iran intel, Nancy Guthrie
- [Kristi Noem Fired from DHS](https://yahoo.com/news/articles/kristi-noem-thanks-trump-first-202718670.html): Kristi Noem fired from DHS, appointed special envoy by Trump for Shield mission
- [Nancy Guthrie FBI Investigation Update](https://yahoo.com/news/articles/nancy-guthrie-former-fbi-agent-113000450.html): FBI investigation update on Nancy Guthrie kidnapping, Savannah Guthrie's mother

## Developer Resources

- [Sign In With Yahoo (OAuth)](https://developer.yahoo.com/sign-in-with-yahoo): OAuth authentication guide for integrating Sign In With Yahoo in apps
- [Web Performance Best Practices](https://developer.yahoo.com/performance/rules.html): 35 web performance best practices: CDN, HTTP, Gzip, CSS/JavaScript optimization
- [Yahoo Finance Features](https://finance.yahoo.com/about/top-features): Yahoo Finance features overview: real-time quotes, charts, portfolio tools

## Reference

- [Yahoo Everything Directory](https://yahoo.com/all): Complete directory of Yahoo products/services from Autos to Fantasy Sports
